name: Michael Castro
title: Digital Growth & Measurement
bio: I build digital acquisition and measurement systems that connect traffic, leads, CRM activity, and revenue.
aboutLong: My work sits at the intersection of acquisition, analytics, and technology. I build and improve systems spanning paid search, GA4, Google Tag Manager, attribution, CRM and lead tracking, executive reporting, and revenue measurement. I also build independent digital projects to test lead-generation, conversion, and monetization strategies firsthand.
